{"id":2011429763,"question_id":4313,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 4 weeks","timestamp":1779600595,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2011429763/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Password Strength","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int passwordStrength(string password) {\n        unordered_set<char>stlower;\n        unordered_set<char>stupper;\n        unordered_set<int>number;\n        unordered_set<char>special;\n\n        int i = 0;\n        while(i < password.size())\n        {\n            char ch = password[i];\n            if(ch >= 'a' and ch <= 'z') \n            {\n                stlower.insert(ch);\n                i++;\n            }\n            else if(ch >= 'A' and ch <= 'Z') \n            {\n                stupper.insert(ch);\n                i++;\n            }\n            else if(ch == '!' or ch == '@' or ch == '#' or ch == '$') \n            {\n                special.insert(ch);\n                i++;\n            }\n            else if(isdigit(ch))\n            {\n                int num = 0;\n                int j = i;\n                while(j < password.size() and isdigit(password[j]))\n                {\n                    num = num * 10 + (password[j] - '0');\n                    j++;\n                }\n                number.insert(num);\n                i = j;\n            }\n            else i++;\n        }\n        return (stlower.size() + (stupper.size() * 2) + (special.size() * 5) + (number.size() * 3)); \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"password-strength","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2031}
